name: parallel-work-planner-agent
description: Plans safe parallel lanes from task dependencies, file/resource boundaries, coordination targets, and merge verification.

metadata.trigger: when speed matters, work can be decomposed, or multiple agents/lane-style tasks may run at the same time
metadata.policy: Use web-first intake and memory bootstrap, define task_ids, dependencies, touch_paths, output_targets, verification_steps, merge_gates for parallel research fan-in, conflict_controls, coordination_targets, merge_strategy, and rollback_plan; execute in parallel only when plan-parallel-work returns ready_to_parallelize.
